description: This file contains implementation of utility functions related to the SLAP Loam Client Object, including translation between different representations of objects and parameter lists within the SLAP environment, especially for message handling such as INVO_ANSWER and INVO_CALL. It involves object import/export, environment translation, and object handle conversion mechanisms.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoLpcToLoaImcpInvoAnswer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE lpc_party_addr,void * pImcpAnswer)
methods.description: Translates an IMCP SLAP_INVO_ANSWER message, potentially creating or interpreting SLAP objects within the Loam Client context.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapLcoLpcToLoaSlapObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE lpc_party_addr,ANSC_HANDLE obj_handle,ULONG obj_type,char * obj_name,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * import_param_list)
methods.description: Transforms an LPC handle into a Loam Object Agent, involving object type and name retrieval, and possibly invoking object export/import procedures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoLoaToLpcImcpInvoCall(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE lpc_party_addr,void * pImcpCall)
methods.description: Converts an IMCP SLAP_INVO_CALL message, translating LOA object handles into LPC handles.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapLcoLoaToLpcSlapObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE lpc_party_addr,ANSC_HANDLE obj_handle)
methods.description: Translates a LOA object handle into an LPC object handle, including optional object export and import in the process.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoLoaToUoaParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Converts a parameter list from LOA to UOA environment for further processing.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoUoaToLoaParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Converts a parameter list from UOA to LOA environment for use within the SLAP context.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoLoaToUoaVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_VARIABLE * slap_var)
methods.description: Converts a SLAP_VARIABLE from LOA to UOA, translating object handles accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoUoaToLoaVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_VARIABLE * slap_var)
methods.description: Converts a SLAP_VARIABLE from UOA to LOA, creating or managing object agents as needed.

ctags.name: SlapLcoLpcToLoaSlapObject
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE lpc_party_addr,ANSC_HANDLE obj_handle,ULONG obj_type,char * obj_name,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * import_param_list)
